blocks.raw: <ExamTip>The LEA tests structural *conceptualization* — not structural *design*. You will rarely be asked to perform full engineering calculations. You will frequently be asked to identify the correct structural system for a scenario, recognize load paths, apply NSCP provisions conceptually, and interpret structural drawings.</ExamTip>

blocks.raw: <Tip>Concrete and reinforced concrete dominate Philippine construction and therefore dominate the exam. Spend proportionally more time here. Steel is second. Timber and masonry are tested but lighter in weight.</Tip>
